name: DynamoDB
description:
DynamoDB Plugin provides integration with local or AWS DynamoDB. It allows to browse and edit tables, run queries, export and import data and more.

Features:

  • Connect to local or AWS DynamoDB
  • Browse data in Table, JSON or DynamoDB JSON view, with paginating and filtering
  • PartiQL queries with autocompletion
  • API operations with autocompletion and documentation
  • Easily scan or query your data with simple expression DSL
  • Save your requests to Favorites or keep them in project files
  • Create, Update or Delete items in table or in JSON editor dialog
  • Export items to CSV, JSON, DynamoDB JSON
  • Copy tables or Import from CSV, JSON, DynamoDB JSON
  • Much more!

Documentation

To get more information about plugin features and usage, please visit the Documentation.

Troubleshooting

We’d love to get your help in making DynamoDB Plugin better! If you have feedback or encounter any problems, please create a GitHub issue or email us at support@dynamodb-idea.com.

docText:
Installation:

  1. Go to Preferences|Plugins. Select Marketplace tab and search for DynamoDB
  2. Select DynamoDB plugin and click the Install button.
  3. When installation is finished, click the Restart IDE button.

Create connection:

  1. Click DynamoDB tab on the right side of the screen to Open DynamoDB tool window
  2. Click the plus button to open Add connection dialog
  3. Specify the connection details, test the connection using Test Connection button and click OK
